2xs.$description: The thinnest space, like the block padding of a badge or the gap under the text of a link.

xs.$description: A tight space, like the gap between a field and its label, or the padding of a list option.

sm.$description: The space between the parts of a component, like the items of a breadcrumb, and the padding of a control.

md.$description: The padding of a region inside a component, like an alert or a drawer.

lg.$description: A wide padding, like the inline padding of a large button.

xl.$description: The space between the regions of a page, and their block padding.

2xl.$description: The widest space, for the layout of a page: no component uses it.

size.$description: Sizes of elements set inside a component.

icon.$description: An icon next to body text: the 24px grid of the icons.

icon-sm.$description: Width and height of a small icon inside a control: the chevrons of the components.

choice.$description: The box of a checkbox or of a radio, and the thumb of a switch, next to body text.

panel.$description: The inline size of a panel along an edge of the page: a drawer.

popup.$description: The largest block size of a popup, like a list of suggestions: its content scrolls past it.

indicator-sm.$description: A small loading or progress indicator, inside a control.

indicator-md.$description: A loading or progress indicator next to body text.

indicator-lg.$description: A loading indicator that stands for a whole region.

table.$description: The largest block size of a table: none by default, the page scrolls.

page.$description: The largest inline size of a page's content: its header, its body and its footer.

navigation.$description: The inline size of a navigation beside the content of a page.

content-min.$description: The smallest inline size of a page's content beside its navigation: narrower, the navigation goes above it.

sm.$description: Small elements, like a badge, a checkbox or an option of a list.

md.$description: Controls and their containers, like a button, a field or an alert.

full.$description: Pill and circle shapes, like a switch, a tag or a progress bar.

body.$description: Text of the page and of the components.

sm.$description: Secondary text, like a hint, an error message or a badge.

md.$description: Body text, and the text of the controls.

lg.$description: Headings inside a component, like the heading of a modal or of a drawer.

xl.$description: The heading of a section of a page.

medium.$description: Labels, like the label of a field or of a button.

semibold.$description: Headings and emphasis, like the heading of a modal or the current item of a navigation.

body.$description: Body text, and the text of the controls.

heading.$description: Large headings, from the heading of a section up: tighter than body text.

normal.$description: The letter spacing of the text styles.

text.$description: Text styles: a family, a size, a weight, a letter spacing and a line height that go together. Each one is also a class of the page sheet, and a text style in Figma.

xl.$description: The heading of a page: its h1.

lg.$description: The heading of a section of a page: an h2.

md.$description: The heading of a region, like a subsection, or the heading of a modal or of a drawer: an h3.

sm.$description: A minor heading, the size of body text, like the heading of a group of fields: an h4.

md.$description: Body text: the default text of the page.

sm.$description: Secondary text, like a caption, a hint or a footnote.

width.$description: The border of a form control, like a text field.

width-thick.$description: A line that carries information: the ring of a spinner, a progress bar.

focus-ring.$description: The focus indicator, the same in every component.

width.$description: The thickness of the focus ring.

offset.$description: The space between a focused element and its focus ring.

overlay.$description: A popup outside the top layer, in the browsers without the Popover API.

raised.$description: A surface above the page, like a card.

overlay.$description: A surface above everything, like a modal.

duration.$description: Zero when the user asks for reduced motion (motion.reduced), but `loop`, slower.

fast.$description: A small change, like the hover of a button or a popup that opens.

base.$description: A larger change, like a modal or a drawer that enters.

loop.$description: One turn of an animation that repeats while something loads.

standard.$description: The curve of every transition of the components.

scale.$description: One when the user asks for reduced motion (motion.reduced).

enter.$description: The scale an overlay enters from and leaves to, like a modal.
